verdict.rationale: Postmark is an email delivery SaaS that could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no built-in AI assistant. The llms.txt file and the community-mentioned official MCP server are building blocks for external agents or belong to a different story, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
